title: The Pauli gates: changing components and signs
objectives: Apply I, X, Y and Z to complex state columns.
Relate Pauli action to half-turns of the Bloch sphere.
prerequisites: Chapter 3: matrix multiplication, adjoints and unitarity. Chapter 4: amplitudes, relative phase, Born probabilities and the Bloch sphere.

quizzes.question: What is Y(α,β)ᵀ?
feedback: Correct: retain both factors of i.

quizzes.question: Why can Z change plus observably while leaving basis 1 physically equivalent?
options: A sign on the only nonzero component is global; a sign between two components is relative.
feedback: The ideal gate is deterministic and linear.
Correct: the input determines whether the sign is global or relative.
Z is a unitary gate, not a measurement.
